items.content_text:
### External Services

*   [MapleStory-Pin-Box (⭐1)](https://github.com/YunJuho0010/MapleStory-Pin-Box) - Update a pinned gist to show your MapleStory (KMS) character's level, job, combat power, and server.
*   [nba-box (⭐1)](https://github.com/23seriy/nba-box) - Update a pinned gist to contain your favourite NBA team stats, record, and recent game results.

*   [storygraph-box (⭐2)](https://github.com/chindris-mihai-alexandru/storygraph-box) - Update a pinned gist to contain your latest StoryGraph reads, listens and Audible listening time.

items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### App Builder

*   [EveryApp](https://everyapp.pro/app-builder) - AI app builder that turns a plain-language description into your own private web app at its own address, shared with the people you invite. `#freemium` `#nocode`

### Design

*   [Cross-Stitch Studio](https://cross-stitch.erwan-boehm.fr/photo-to-cross-stitch?utm_source=directory) - Turn photos into editable cross-stitch charts with DMC thread colors and optional AI photo preparation. `#freemium` `#design`

### Developer Tools

*   [No Stairs Please MCP](https://nostairsplease.com/mcp) - Remote MCP server for searching 2,200+ North American live-music venues, load-in stairs, drive-time routing, and booking contacts. `#freemium` `#mcp`
*   [Sage (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/ZHangZHengEric/Sage) - Open-source agent harness with Desktop, Server and Python hosts, MCP tools, and task-feedback evaluation with user-selected version adoption; configured model providers may charge usage fees. `#opensource` `#agents`
*   [Shazeus](https://www.shazeus.com/en/skills) - Free English and Turkish directory of agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with source repositories, pinned revisions, license links, and install commands. `#free`

items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

*   [AInnotator (⭐2)](https://github.com/porco-rs/ainnotator) - Screenshot annotation tool that turns numbered marks, notes, and redactions into one self-explaining image to paste into Claude Code, Codex, or ChatGPT, including over SSH. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/porco-rs/ainnotator) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

*   [Purr](https://purr.arunbrahma.com) - Open-source on-device dictation that types into any app with Parakeet or Whisper, plus meeting notes with speaker labels and summaries. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/iamarunbrahma/purr) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

*   [SoundLadder (⭐1)](https://github.com/dirkkredinger/SoundLadder) - Menu bar app that picks the audio output from a ranked list and falls back to the next connected device automatically. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/dirkkredinger/SoundLadder) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / File Organization Tools

*   [neatly](https://alpozaydin.github.io/neatly/) - AI file renamer that names downloads, screenshots and photos by their content, on-device with Apple Intelligence. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/alpozaydin/neatly) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

items.title: Public Apis
items.content_text:
### APIs Covered Under APILayer Suite!

- Name: [aamio](https://aamio.at/)

  Description: Ephemeral rendezvous for agents: expiring threads, receipts and an open board

  Auth: No

  Transport: `HTTP`

  Install: [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/at.aamio/aamio)


- Name: [Octocrawl](https://octocrawl.dev/docs/connect-mcp/)

  Description: Web pages as Markdown or JSON with an Evidence Record; a blocked or empty page returns a reason

  Auth: No

  Transport: `stdio`, `HTTP`

  Install: [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/77777R7/Octocrawl) · [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=io.github.77777R7/octocrawl)


- Name: [Sofya (⭐2)](https://github.com/sofya-co/sofya-mcp)

  Description: Web search with its own index, pages as Markdown, AI extraction and cited research reports

  Auth: `apiKey`

  Transport: `stdio`, `HTTP`

  Install: [Anthropic](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/sofya) · [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/co.sofya/sofya) · [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=co.sofya/sofya)



### Anime

- API: [FillerLists](https://fillerlists.com/data)

  Description: Filler, mixed and canon labels for every episode of 13 long anime (JSON and CSV)

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Blockchain

- API: [Verifyum](https://verifyum.com/agents)

  Description: File timestamp proofs anchored on Solana from a locally computed commitment, no file upload

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No



### Books

- API: [Readark](https://readark.app/developers/)

  Description: Dark romance books with spice and darkness ratings, subgenres, tropes and authors

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Calendar

- API: [SalahTable](https://salahtable.com/prayer-times-api)

  Description: Islamic prayer times for 400+ cities, by day or month, with six calculation methods

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes


- API: [TradingCalendars](https://tradingcalendars.com/documentation)

  Description: Market holidays and business days for FX, banks, payment systems and exchanges, with early closes

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No



### Cryptocurrency

- API: [CryptoDataAPI](https://cryptodataapi.com/api/docs)

  Description: Prices, derivatives, funding, liquidations, Hyperliquid, ETF flows, volatility index and regimes

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No


- API: [Gasrent](https://gasrent.click/api.html)

  Description: TRON energy and bandwidth rental aggregator with public price and health endpoints

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Development

- API: [AI SENSE](https://aisense.no/free-public-apis)

  Description: Utility endpoints: time, hashing, encoding, QR, JSON, images, webhooks, temporary storage

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes


- API: [Octocrawl](https://octocrawl.dev/docs/reference/)

  Description: Web pages as Markdown or JSON with an Evidence Record: final URL, HTTP status, robots.txt, hashes

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No


- API: [SuprSend](https://docs.suprsend.com/reference/overview)

  Description: Multi-channel notifications: workflows, templates and preferences for email, SMS, push and in-app

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Documents & Productivity

- API: [KaijuConverter](https://kaijuconverter.com/api-docs)

  Description: Convert 201+ file formats, OCR, PDF/A & exact KB compression

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Email

- API: [MailTester Ninja](https://mailtester.ninja/api/)

  Description: Verify email addresses live with the mail server, catch-all and disposable detection, free tier

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Finance

- API: [AIR Stock Discovery](https://www.aistockradars.com/developers)

  Description: AI-scored SEC filing events for small and mid-cap US companies

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Unknown

  : 


- API: [IBANforge](https://ibanforge.com/docs)

  Description: IBAN checks and sourced bank/BIC references; free format checks and a keyless validation trial

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No



### Games & Comics

- API: [Valo.Data](https://valotcg.com/developers/api/pokemon)

  Description: Pokémon TCG cards in EN/FR/JA/ZH, Cardmarket, US market and eBay prices, PSA populations, 14 TCGs

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Geocoding

- API: [GetParcelData](https://getparceldata.com/api)

  Description: US parcel boundaries, owners and assessor values by APN, point or polygon

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Government

- API: [Election Night Results](https://pushbuild.com/apis/election-night-results.html)

  Description: Live US election results from official state feeds, statewide and by county; free tier

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No



### Machine Learning

- API: [AI Rate Card](https://airatecard.com/docs)

  Description: Daily-checked AI model API prices from 120+ providers, price history and cost estimates

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Music

- API: [Open Guitar Chords](https://openguitarchords.com/data)

  Description: Free JSON data for guitar chords, scales and fretboard positions

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Transportation

- API: [VakayMood](https://vakaymood.com/developers)

  Description: Live timeshare resort rental inventory: stay dates, nightly rates, resort fees and booking URLs

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Video

- API: [Galaxy Movies](https://galaxymovies.app/api/streaming-changes?provider=netflix)

  Description: Daily arrivals and departures per US streaming service

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes

items.content_text:
### AI / Diagnostics

*   [vshulcz/deja-vu (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu) - Local session search, line-level blame, and cross-agent handoff via Snacks, Telescope, or `fzf-lua`.

### Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

*   [dybdeskarphet/min.nvim (⭐19)](https://github.com/dybdeskarphet/min.nvim) - ***`[TS][LSP][L/D][Lua]`*** A minimal colorscheme with several flavors, conceptually inspired by Alabaster.
